info.title: Synapse REST API
info.description: The Open API documentation for the Synapse REST API

parameters.name: Status.Phase
parameters.description: Gets/sets the correlation's status phase

parameters.name: Status.LastModified
parameters.description: Gets/sets the date and time the correlation was last modified at

parameters.name: Status.Contexts
parameters.description: Gets/sets a list containing the contexts that have been created for the described correlation

parameters.name: Spec.Lifetime
parameters.description: Gets/sets the correlation's lifetime

parameters.name: Spec.Keys
parameters.description: Gets/sets a key/value mapping, if any, of the keys to use to correlate events

parameters.name: Spec.Stream
parameters.description: Gets/sets a boolean indicating whether or not to stream events. When enabled, each correlated event is atomically published to the subscriber immediately rather than waiting for the entire correlation to complete

parameters.name: Spec.Outcome.Type
parameters.description: Gets the type of the correlation outcome

parameters.name: Spec.Outcome.Start.Workflow
parameters.description: Gets/sets the workflow to start upon correlation

parameters.name: Spec.Outcome.Start.Input
parameters.description: Gets/sets a key/value mapping of the input of the workflow to start upon correlation

parameters.name: Spec.Outcome.Correlate.Instance
parameters.description: Gets/sets a '{name}.{namespace}' reference to the workflow instance to correlate

parameters.name: Spec.Outcome.Correlate.Task
parameters.description: Gets/sets the name of the task that consumes the correlated events

parameters.name: Status.Phase
parameters.description: Gets/sets the correlator's current status phase

parameters.name: Spec.Selector
parameters.description:
Gets/sets a key/value mapping of the labels to select correlations by.<para></para>
If not set, the broker will attempt to pick up all unclaimed workflows and workflow instances

parameters.name: Spec.Versions
parameters.description: Gets/sets the versions of the configured custom function

parameters.name: Status.Phase
parameters.description: Gets/sets the operator's current status phase

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Native.Directory
parameters.description: Gets/sets the runner's working directory

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Native.Executable
parameters.description: Gets/sets the path to the file to execute to run a workflow instance

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Native.SecretsDirectory
parameters.description: Gets/sets the path to the directory that contains the secrets made available to runners

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Docker.Api.Endpoint
parameters.description: Gets/sets the endpoint of the Docker API to use

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Docker.Api.Version
parameters.description: Gets/sets the version of the Docker API to use

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Docker.ImageRegistry
parameters.description: Gets/sets the name of the image registry to use when pulling the runtime's container image

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Docker.ImagePullPolicy
parameters.description: Gets/sets the Docker image pull policy. Supported values are 'Always', 'IfNotPresent' and 'Never'. Defaults to 'Always'.

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Docker.Secrets.Directory
parameters.description: Gets/sets the path to the directory that contains the secrets to mount

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Docker.Secrets.MountPath
parameters.description: Gets/sets the path to the folder to mount the secrets volume to

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Docker.Network
parameters.description: Gets/sets the name of the network, if any, to connect Runner containers to

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Kubernetes.Kubeconfig
parameters.description: Gets/sets the path to the Kubeconfig file to use, if any. If not set, defaults to 'InCluster' configuration

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Kubernetes.Secrets.VolumeName
parameters.description: Gets/sets the name of the volume on which to mounts secrets

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Kubernetes.Secrets.MountPath
parameters.description: Gets/sets the path to the folder to mount the secrets volume to

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Kubernetes.Namespace
parameters.description: Gets/sets the namespace in which to create runner pods. If not set, defaults to the namespace defined in the Synapse.Resources.KubernetesRuntimeConfiguration.PodTemplate

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Kubernetes.ServiceAccount
parameters.description: Gets/sets the name of the service account that grants the runner the ability to spawn containers when its container platform has been set to `kubernetes`

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Runtime.Mode
parameters.description: Gets the runtime mode

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.ContainerPlatform
parameters.description: Gets/sets the container platform used by runners to spawn containers

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.Certificates.Validate
parameters.description: Gets/sets a boolean indicating whether or not to validate certificates when performing requests

parameters.name: Spec.Runner.PublishLifecycleEvents
parameters.description: Gets/sets a boolean indicating whether or not runners spawned by the configured Synapse Operators should publish lifecycle events

parameters.name: Spec.Selector
parameters.description:
Gets/sets a key/value mapping of the labels to select both workflows and workflow instances by.<para></para>
If not set, the broker will attempt to pick up all unclaimed workflows and workflow instances

parameters.name: Spec.Cleanup.Ttl
parameters.description: Gets or sets the time to live for completed workflow instances. Defaults to 7 days. If null, the operator will not delete completed workflow instances.

parameters.name: Spec.Cleanup.Interval
parameters.description: Gets or sets the interval at which the operator sweeps for completed workflow instances to delete. Defaults to 5 minutes.

parameters.name: Spec.Key
parameters.description: Gets/sets the service account's key

parameters.name: Spec.Claims
parameters.description: Gets/sets the claims associated to the service account

parameters.name: IsOperative
parameters.description: Gets a value indicating whether the workflow is in an operative state, meaning it is pending, running, or suspended, and can potentially resume execution.

parameters.name: Status.Phase
parameters.description: Gets/sets the current phase of the workflow

parameters.name: Status.ProcessId
parameters.description: Gets/sets the unique identifier of the process that is executing the workflow instance, if applicable

parameters.name: Status.StartedAt
parameters.description: Gets/sets the date and time the task has been started at, if applicable

parameters.name: Status.EndedAt
parameters.description: Gets/sets the date and time the task has ended, if applicable

parameters.name: Status.Tasks
parameters.description: Gets/sets a list containing the tasks that are being performed -or already have been performed- by the workflow

parameters.name: Status.Runs
parameters.description: Gets/sets a list that contains the workflow's runs, if any

parameters.name: Status.Correlation.Keys
parameters.description: Gets/sets a name/value containing the workflow instance's correlation keys

parameters.name: Status.Correlation.Contexts
parameters.description: Gets/sets a name/value containing the workflow instance's correlation contexts pending processing

parameters.name: Status.Error.Type
parameters.description: Gets/sets an uri that reference the type of the described problem.

parameters.name: Status.Error.Title
parameters.description: Gets/sets a short, human-readable summary of the problem type.It SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

parameters.name: Status.Error.Status
parameters.description: Gets/sets the status code produced by the described problem

parameters.name: Status.Error.Detail
parameters.description: Gets/sets a human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

parameters.name: Status.Error.Instance
parameters.description: Gets/sets a System.Uri reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem. It may or may not yield further information if dereferenced.

parameters.name: Status.Error.ExtensionData
parameters.description: Gets/sets a mapping containing problem details extension data, if any

parameters.name: Status.ContextReference
parameters.description: Gets/sets a reference to the workflow's context data, if any

parameters.name: Status.OutputReference
parameters.description: Gets/sets a reference to the workflow's context data, if any

parameters.name: Spec.Definition
parameters.description: Gets/sets the definition of the workflow to run

parameters.name: Spec.Input
parameters.description: Gets/sets a name/value mapping of the workflow's input data

parameters.name: Status.Versions
parameters.description: Gets/sets a key/value mapping of the status of the workflow's versions
